passwordRules.title: The password must:
passwordRules.notPersonal: not look like your name or email

auth.otpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code sent to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.resent: A new code has been sent.
auth.pendingHelp: Your email is verified. HR now needs to approve your account; you will get an email as soon as it is active.
auth.forgotHelp: Enter your work email and we will send a link valid for 30 minutes. You can also ask HR to reset your password.
auth.linkSent: If this email exists, a link has been sent.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. You can log in.
auth.mustChangeHelp: You logged in with a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.

menus.title: This week's menus
menus.dayClosedHelp: The canteen is closed that day.
menus.notEnough: Not enough balance for this meal ({{price}} TND).
menus.refunded: Reservation cancelled: {{amount}} TND paid back to your balance.

balance.title: My balance
balance.howHelp: To top up your balance, give the money to the canteen staff: they record it straight away. Each meal is paid from your balance when you reserve it, and paid back if you cancel before {{cutoff}}.

reservations.title: My reservations
reservations.showQr: Show this code at the canteen entrance.

scan.title: Scan meals
scan.hint: Start the camera and point it at the QR code on the employee's phone.

cash.title: Cash received
cash.help: Money received at the canteen that day: top-ups recorded by each person, and management corrections, which count in the total.
cash.helpMine: All the money you recorded today. This is the amount to hand over to management at the end of the day.

cashier.title: Cashier — top up a balance
cashier.help: An employee gives you money: find their account, enter the amount received and record it. They get a notification with their new balance.
cashier.correctHelp: To fix a mistake (wrong amount, wrong person). Negative amount to take money off. The reason is kept and the employee is told.

attendance.title: Attendance per employee
attendance.help: For each employee and for the month: meals reserved, served, no-shows, cancellations. "Not served yet" = reservations for coming days, or for today before service ends: they only become a no-show if the day ends without a scan. Click an employee to see their days.
attendance.overThreshold: {{count}} employee(s) with {{n}} no-shows or more this month

dayList.title: Reservations of the day
dayList.absentAfter: Reservations not served yet only become "No-show" at the end of service ({{time}}), once the day is over.

settings.title: Canteen settings
settings.help: Changes apply at once (within a minute), for today and the following days. A step already passed (a day closed or finalized) is not undone. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.cutoffHint: When reservations for day D close. 0 days = the same morning.
settings.publishHint: Otherwise the day opens as "Menu to be announced". Must come before reservations close.
settings.finalizationHint: Plate count locked; without confirmation, automatic finalization with the buffer.
settings.remindersHint: The management reminder must come before finalization; the employee reminder goes out the evening before reservations close.
settings.bufferHint: The same buffer is used for the proposal shown to management and for automatic finalization (rounded up).
settings.saved: Settings saved. They apply from now on.

dishes.title: Dish library
dishes.name: Dish name
dishes.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB max. It shows on the day's card employees see.
dishes.empty: No dishes yet. Add your first dish.
dishes.archiveConfirm: Archive "{{name}}"? It will disappear from the dish picker but stay in past menus.

planner.title: Menu planner
planner.help: A day's menu must be published at least {{days}} days ahead, by {{time}}. Otherwise the day opens as "Menu to be announced".
planner.libraryEmpty: The library is empty: create a dish with "New dish".
planner.sourceEmpty: That day has no dishes to copy.
planner.closeHelp: The day can no longer be reserved and existing reservations will be cancelled.
planner.menu2Help: Optional: a second menu employees can choose instead. Leave empty for a single menu.

finalize.title: Meal finalization
finalize.help: After reservations close ({{cutoff}}), confirm how many plates to prepare. Without confirmation, the system finalizes automatically at {{time}}.
finalize.empty: No published day in the next 7 days.
finalize.paymentOff: Payment is turned off in the settings: every meal is free.
finalize.priceHelp: Can change until {{cutoff}}. A new price only applies to reservations made after it.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.help: Employees sign up without an employee number. Check each request, then enter the employee number when approving the account.

confirm.suspend: Suspend {{name}}'s account? They will no longer be able to reserve.
confirm.makeAdmin: Give {{name}} the role "{{role}}"? They will be able to manage every account, role and setting.

accounts.approved: {{name}} is approved. An email has been sent.
accounts.approveHelp: Check that {{email}} is really an employee, then enter their employee number.
accounts.tempHelp: Give this password to {{name}} in person. They will have to choose a new one at their next login. Valid for {{hours}} hours.
accounts.tempOnce: This password will not be shown again. It is never sent by email.

notifications.title: Notifications

push.on: On: you receive them even when the app is closed.
push.off: Off on this device. Turn them on to be told without opening the app.
push.denied: Blocked by the browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser settings.
push.unsupported: Not available here: the app must be on HTTPS (on iPhone, add it to the home screen first).
push.disabled_on_server: Not set up on the server yet. Notifications are still shown in the app.

notifications.eveningHelp: At {{time}}, if you have not reserved yet (reservations close at {{cutoff}}).

soon.title: Screen to build
soon.help: This screen is planned in the specification ({{refs}}). It will be built in an upcoming sprint.

errors.settings_no_service_day: Keep at least one service day.

errors.settings_cutoff_after_finalization: Reservations must close before the finalization time.
errors.settings_finalization_after_service: Finalization must happen at the latest when service starts.
errors.settings_service_end_before_start: Service must end after it starts.
errors.settings_reminder_after_finalization: The management reminder must come before the finalization time.
errors.settings_reminder_after_cutoff: The employee reminder must come before reservations close.
errors.settings_unknown_field: This setting cannot be changed here.
errors.email_not_verified: Your email is not verified yet.
errors.pending_hr: Your account is waiting for HR approval.
errors.suspended: Your account is suspended. Contact HR.
errors.temp_password_expired: Your temporary password has expired. Contact HR.
errors.otp_expired: Code expired. Request a new one.
errors.otp_resend_too_soon: Wait 60 seconds before requesting a new code.
errors.otp_too_many: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
errors.reservation_closed: Reservations for this day are closed.
errors.reset_link_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.wrong_date: This code is not for today.
errors.http_403: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.http_429: Too many attempts from this device. Please try again a little later.
errors.menu_locked: This menu can no longer be edited (reservations closed).
errors.dish_not_found: One of the dishes no longer exists or is archived.
errors.not_draft: Only a draft menu can be published.
errors.menu_empty: Add at least one dish before publishing.
errors.publish_deadline_passed: The publishing deadline has passed: the day will open as "Menu to be announced".
errors.cannot_close: Only a draft or published day can be closed.
errors.not_locked: Finalization is possible only after reservations close.
errors.finalization_closed: The finalization deadline has passed: the plate count is locked.
errors.below_reserved: The final count cannot be below the number of reservations.
errors.above_kitchen_max: The count exceeds the kitchen's maximum capacity.
errors.not_pending: This account is no longer pending.
errors.invalid_transition: This status change is not possible.
errors.employee_number_taken: Another account already has this employee number.
errors.admin_only: Only an admin can change roles.
errors.cannot_change_own_role: You cannot change your own role.
errors.last_admin: This is the last active admin: they must keep the role.
errors.photo_invalid: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.photo_too_large: The photo must be 5 MB or less.
errors.insufficient_balance: Not enough balance. Top it up at the canteen.
errors.invalid_choice: This menu is not offered that day.
errors.choice_has_reservations: Employees reserved menu 2: it can no longer be removed.
errors.plates_per_menu_required: Give the number of plates for each menu.
errors.amount_positive: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.management_only: Only management can correct a balance.
errors.payment_frozen: The price is frozen after reservations close.
errors.price_required: Give a price for a paid day.
